subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should this issue be fixed narrowly by making explicit `heartbeat.session` override wake-origin `forcedSessionKey`, or should it also change default Telegram DM isolation away from documented `session.dmScope=main` behavior?
rationale: The source-backed bug is the explicit heartbeat session losing to an originating session, while default Telegram DM isolation would alter documented defaults and existing users' session-sharing behavior.

options.title: Fix heartbeat precedence only
options.body: Make explicit `heartbeat.session` win for exec/system-event-triggered wakes, add regression tests, and leave default Telegram DM scope unchanged.

options.title: Broaden to Telegram DM isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DM defaults or plugin behavior with docs, migration guidance, and upgrade proof for existing main-session users.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Pause implementation until a current-main Telegram heartbeat plus exec-event reproduction confirms the failure outside source inspection.

recommendation.title: Fix heartbeat precedence only
recommendation.body: Make explicit `heartbeat.session` win for exec/system-event-triggered wakes, add regression tests, and leave default Telegram DM scope unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best available owner from the related session-routing fix history and already closed the adjacent dmScope event-wake issue with proof.
